title: Induction Continues Through Research Registration
statement: Induction is not terminal; explicitly inducted work continues through research identity, provisional structure, projections, and validation until research registration or a visible governed blocker.
formal_expression: EXPLICIT_INDUCTION(x) => PRESERVE(x) AND QUEUE_REGISTER(x) AND CONTINUE_UNTIL(RESEARCH_REGISTERED(x) OR RESEARCH_BLOCKED_VISIBLE(x))
